import Mathlib

def sum_lengths (cuts : List Nat) : Nat :=
  cuts.foldl (· + ·) 0

def get_price (prices : List Nat) (len : Nat) : Nat :=
  if len > 0 then prices.getD (len - 1) 0 else 0

def calculate_revenue (cuts : List Nat) (prices : List Nat) : Nat :=
  cuts.foldl (fun acc len => acc + get_price prices len) 0

def is_valid_strategy (cuts : List Nat) (n : Nat) (prices : List Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ len ∈ cuts, len > 0 ∧ len - 1 < prices.length) ∧
  sum_lengths cuts = n

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rod_cutting_precond (n : Nat) (prices : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  prices.length ≥ n ∧
  n ≤ 1000 ∧
  (∀ i, i < prices.length → prices.getD i 0 ≤ 10000)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def best (prices : List Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 =>
    ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun i => get_price prices (i + 1) + best prices (n - i))).foldl max 0
termination_by n => n
decreasing_by omega
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def rod_cutting (n : Nat) (prices : List Nat)
    (h_precond : rod_cutting_precond n prices) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  best prices n
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rod_cutting_postcond (n : Nat) (prices : List Nat) (result : Nat)
    (_ : rod_cutting_precond n prices) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ cuts, is_valid_strategy cuts n prices → calculate_revenue cuts prices ≤ result) ∧
  (∃ cuts, is_valid_strategy cuts n prices ∧ calculate_revenue cuts prices = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma best_zero (prices : List Nat) : best prices 0 = 0 := by
  rw [best]

lemma best_succ (prices : List Nat) (m : Nat) :
    best prices (m + 1) =
      ((List.range (m + 1)).map
        (fun i => get_price prices (i + 1) + best prices (m - i))).foldl max 0 := by
  rw [best]

lemma foldl_add_acc (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat),
    l.foldl (fun acc x => acc + f x) a = a + l.foldl (fun acc x => acc + f x) 0 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, Nat.zero_add]
    rw [ih (a + f x), ih (f x)]
    omega

lemma foldl_sum_acc : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat),
    l.foldl (· + ·) a = a + l.foldl (· + ·) 0 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, Nat.zero_add]
    rw [ih (a + x), ih x]
    omega

lemma revenue_cons (prices : List Nat) (x : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    calculate_revenue (x :: xs) prices = get_price prices x + calculate_revenue xs prices := by
  unfold calculate_revenue
  simp only [List.foldl_cons, Nat.zero_add]
  exact foldl_add_acc (get_price prices) xs (get_price prices x)

lemma sum_lengths_cons (x : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    sum_lengths (x :: xs) = x + sum_lengths xs := by
  unfold sum_lengths
  simp only [List.foldl_cons, Nat.zero_add]
  exact foldl_sum_acc xs x

lemma foldl_max_ge : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), a ≤ l.foldl max a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    exact le_trans (le_max_left a x) (ih (max a x))

lemma le_foldl_max_of_mem : ∀ (l : List Nat) (x a : Nat), x ∈ l → x ≤ l.foldl max a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro x a h; cases h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    intro x a h
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
    · subst h1
      exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (foldl_max_ge _ _)
    · exact ih x (max a y) h1

lemma foldl_max_mem : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), l.foldl max a ∈ a :: l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons y ys ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    have h := ih (max a y)
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
    · rcases max_choice a y with h2 | h2
      · rw [h1, h2]; simp
      · rw [h1, h2]; simp
    · simp [h1]

lemma foldl_max_eq_mem (l : List Nat) (h : l ≠ []) : ∃ v ∈ l, l.foldl max 0 = v := by
  have hm := foldl_max_mem l 0
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hm with h0 | h0
  · cases l with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl h
    | cons y ys =>
      refine ⟨y, by simp, ?_⟩
      have h1 : y ≤ (y :: ys).foldl max 0 := le_foldl_max_of_mem (y :: ys) y 0 (by simp)
      omega
  · exact ⟨_, h0, rfl⟩

theorem best_upper (prices : List Nat) : ∀ (cuts : List Nat) (n : Nat),
    (∀ len ∈ cuts, 0 < len) → sum_lengths cuts = n →
    calculate_revenue cuts prices ≤ best prices n := by
  intro cuts
  induction cuts with
  | nil =>
    intro n _ hsum
    have hn : n = 0 := by rw [← hsum]; simp [sum_lengths]
    subst hn
    simp [calculate_revenue, best_zero]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro n hpos hsum
    have hx : 0 < x := hpos x (by simp)
    rw [sum_lengths_cons] at hsum
    have htail : calculate_revenue xs prices ≤ best prices (sum_lengths xs) :=
      ih (sum_lengths xs) (fun l hl => hpos l (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl)) rfl
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [revenue_cons, best_succ]
    have hmem : get_price prices x + best prices (sum_lengths xs) ∈
        (List.range (m + 1)).map (fun i => get_price prices (i + 1) + best prices (m - i)) := by
      rw [List.mem_map]
      refine ⟨x - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.mem_range]; omega
      · have h1 : x - 1 + 1 = x := by omega
        have h2 : m - (x - 1) = sum_lengths xs := by omega
        simp only [h1, h2]
    have hle := le_foldl_max_of_mem _ (get_price prices x + best prices (sum_lengths xs)) 0 hmem
    omega

theorem best_exists (prices : List Nat) : ∀ (B n : Nat), n ≤ B → n ≤ prices.length →
    ∃ cuts, (∀ len ∈ cuts, 0 < len ∧ len - 1 < prices.length) ∧ sum_lengths cuts = n ∧
      calculate_revenue cuts prices = best prices n := by
  intro B
  induction B with
  | zero =>
    intro n hn _
    have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hn
    subst hn0
    exact ⟨[], by simp, by simp [sum_lengths], by simp [calculate_revenue, best_zero]⟩
  | succ B ih =>
    intro n hn hlen
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨[], by simp, by simp [sum_lengths], by simp [calculate_revenue, best_zero]⟩
    | succ m =>
      have hL : ((List.range (m + 1)).map
          (fun i => get_price prices (i + 1) + best prices (m - i))) ≠ [] := by
        intro hcon
        have h2 := congrArg List.length hcon
        simp at h2
      obtain ⟨v, hvmem, hveq⟩ := foldl_max_eq_mem _ hL
      rw [List.mem_map] at hvmem
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hiv⟩ := hvmem
      rw [List.mem_range] at hi
      have hiv' : get_price prices (i + 1) + best prices (m - i) = v := hiv
      obtain ⟨cuts, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := ih (m - i) (by omega) (by omega)
      refine ⟨(i + 1) :: cuts, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro len hmem'
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem' with h1 | h1
        · subst h1
          exact ⟨Nat.succ_pos i, by omega⟩
        · exact hc1 len h1
      · rw [sum_lengths_cons, hc2]; omega
      · rw [revenue_cons, hc3, best_succ, hveq]
        exact hiv'
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem rod_cutting_postcond_satisfied (n : Nat) (prices : List Nat)
    (h_precond : rod_cutting_precond n prices) :
    rod_cutting_postcond n prices (rod_cutting n prices h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro cuts hvalid
    exact best_upper prices cuts n (fun len hl => (hvalid.1 len hl).1) hvalid.2
  · obtain ⟨cuts, h1, h2, h3⟩ := best_exists prices n n (le_refl n) h_precond.1
    exact ⟨cuts, ⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
